Dexter’s Catering

Food for your team, party or event.

Tell us what you need and we’ll help put the order together. Catering orders require a minimum of 48 hours’ notice and remain subject to availability and Dexter’s confirmation.

Planning a catering order?

We can cater using items from the current Dexter’s menu. For larger or more complex orders, availability may vary, so please contact us before relying on a particular item or quantity.

Minimum 48 hours’ noticeCollection arrangements confirmed with youAllergen information checked separately

Good for

  • Work lunches and meetings
  • Birthday and family gatherings
  • Community events
  • Team meals
  • Small parties and celebrations
  • Bulk breakfast, lunch or hot-food orders

How to start

Browse our current menu, then email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or message Dexter AI on WhatsApp. We’ll send you the catering order form so everything is captured clearly.

Please don’t send card details, passwords or other sensitive information by email or WhatsApp.

Choose from the menu

Use the live Loyalty App menu for the current customer-facing selection and pricing.

Open Dexter’s Loyalty App

Tell us what you need

We’ll ask for:

  • event or collection date and preferred time
  • number of people
  • exact food items and quantities
  • drinks and extras
  • vegetarian or other dietary requirements
  • allergies and intolerances
  • budget, if relevant
  • name, phone number and email
  • packaging or special instructions

We confirm the order

Your catering request is not confirmed until Dexter’s has checked availability, agreed the details with you and confirmed the order. We may ask for payment or a deposit depending on the size and nature of the order.

Allergies & intolerances

If anyone in your group has a food allergy or intolerance, tell us before the order is confirmed. Do not rely on menu names alone. Ingredients, recipes and supplier products can change.

We will provide the allergen information available for the specific items being ordered. Because food is prepared in a working kitchen, we cannot promise an allergen-free environment unless we have specifically confirmed that in writing for the item concerned.

Read allergen information

Need an answer quickly?

For general questions, Dexter AI on WhatsApp may be the quickest option. For final catering confirmation, allergens, availability or payment, a member of the Dexter’s team may still need to confirm the details.
